summary: Temporary danger area EGD290C for unmanned aircraft beyond visual line of sight, around Holbeach Air Weapons Range, from ground to 2,300 feet.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD290C INSTALLED WI AREA BOUNDED BY
525322.96N 0000709.79E THEN STRAIGHT LINE TO 524938.33N 0001052.43E 
THENCE CLOCKWISE BY THE ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 2.3 NM CENTRED ON 
525152.67N 0001001.83E - 525322.96N 0000709.79E UAS BEYOND VISUAL 
LINE OF SIGHT. ACTIVITY WILL BE CONTAINED WI VCY OF HOLBEACH AIR 
WEAPONS RANGE. FURTHER DETAILS AT HTTP://WWW.NATS-UK.EAD-IT.COM. 
BRIEFING SHEET 134/2026
